releaseNotes: 修复豆包 2.19.9 输入框挂件固定不动与复杂背景文字难读的问题；三端挂件按真实输入框宽度往返，只在 Agent 生成回复时运行，空闲或后台立即暂停；动画改用合成层位移，并限制豆包运行时扫描范围以减少卡顿。
releaseNotesEn: Fixes the stationary Doubao 2.19.9 composer mascot and unreadable text on complex artwork; makes each Agent's mascot traverse the measured composer only while a response is being generated and pause when idle or backgrounded; and reduces layout work and Doubao runtime scanning.
